slides.title: Landscapers: rating how you track renewals
slides.body: Be honest. Which one is you?

slides.label: 0/10 and 2/10
slides.title: Memory. A sticky note on the truck dash.
slides.body: One forgets. The other fades by July.

slides.label: 5/10 and 6/10
slides.title: A spreadsheet. A phone reminder.
slides.body: Fine, if someone opens it. Until you switch phones.

slides.title: Every date in one place, with alerts.
slides.body: License, COI, pesticide cert, truck registration. Off-season is renewal season.
